title: Component: Rubric - Value Binding
evidence: All value criteria bind values to named fields within structured line formats. Log criteria (6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 24, 27, 28, 29, 30) reference specific fields (mechanic=, t=, first=, collected=, actions=, origin=, count=) within named line types (MOTION_SAMPLE, ACTION_TRANSITION). Criterion 25 binds to 'HUD text' at a specific visual location in the screenshot. Tolerance bands on criteria 10 (±10% on sampling interval) and 30 (±20% on AUTO gap) are on derived runtime values from the Godot game engine, not transcribed figures -- the game's frame timer produces these timestamps, so the bands are sound. No single input contains all graded values for any criterion group: gameplay_config.txt provides mechanic id 'bomb' but not timestamps, coordinates, or counters; scene_reference.png shows HUD label text but with static values (0/0) rather than the runtime values (62/89) in the expected file.
